about: The alpha rhythm as a time course on the cortex, from the same inverse solution as the power maps.
signed_note: Values are signed because an oscillation swings both ways. Drawing the magnitude would show two cycles for every real one.
recording: PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database, subject 1, runs 1 and 2. ODC-BY 1.0.
method: dSPM with pick_ori normal, so the sign of the current with respect to the cortical surface is kept.
